deliveroo.source: sales + orders: Deliveroo Tax Invoice PDF (Total Order Value), issued 09/11/2026 + ops from Weekly Summary sheet

issues: Sales were quieter overall: the Abbey Park fireworks did not bring the hoped for footfall, and the week underperformed despite the LRW deal and the year on year comparison.
Covers dropped sharply with less footfall, possibly because of colder weather, Christmas saving or the new loyalty rollout, while spend per head still increased.
Deliveroo sales dropped but the stats stayed stable.
Food cost came back down because less was ordered after the previous week's overstock.
The LWC drinks invoice from Thursday is missing, so the drinks variance is still to be confirmed.
One 2 star review praised the atmosphere and service but criticised food quality, and FOH were asked to do regular check backs to catch issues in store.
Member spend dropped with covers and sales, and new sign up bonuses may be less attractive to Leicester customers.

Fewer labour hours were used week on week, but labour was a higher percentage because of poor sales and authorised training, and the kitchen used extra hours on prep and deep cleaning ahead of an expected EHO visit; labour is running about 2.7 points above the 23% wage target (Admin Meeting 09/11).

Leicester has been the heaviest loss making site for three months; the £5 ramen deal, influencers and pay per click brought no results, loyalty app usage is down 72% since 1 November and only 44 customers returned last week (Admin Meeting 09/11).
Marketing flagged that Leicester's Meta leads and Slerp location are underperforming, and new ad creatives are being made (Weekly DPM meeting 10/11).
Maintenance: the lift is still out so deliveries are put away when quiet, and Ross's door quote was too high so other quotes are being sought.
Upcoming: B2B on 19/11, the Hunger Games film release on 18/11 with an extra FOH for the first three days, and the Christmas lights switch on 18/11.
Staffing: a December holiday needs a Christmas temp, and one FOH from a sushi trial is lined up; Christmas availability has been collected.
The Deliveroo tag has been chased with Matt and needs chasing again.
Leicester was quieter during the local fireworks and Diwali (England KPI meeting 10/11).

England wide: 50% off delivery orders over £20 from Friday; winter menu (pumpkin ramen, merry maki roll) and brown sugar, cinnamon and caramel matcha drinks rolling out; first 3 service steps mandatory by 16/11 with daily shift plans; supply orders must go in early so finance can clear payments; syrup and cinnamon stock issues at several sites (England KPI meeting 10/11).
